notes:
v0.6.34: disable noVNC password (LAN-only security model).

Problem (operator 2026-09-09 15:14 MDT): the random 8-char
noVNC password the bootstrap generated kept breaking the
operator's browser-stored password — every time the bootstrap
re-ran (e.g. to fix a different bug), a new password was
written to /etc/x11vnc/passwd, and the noVNC tab would
silently start rejecting the old password.

The password also provided no real security: anyone with LAN
access to the Pi can already get a root shell via the wifi
client portal or a connected keyboard. The hostapd WPA2
password is the only network-level auth that matters.

Fix:
1. start-novnc-session: removed -rfbauth /etc/x11vnc/passwd
   from the x11vnc command. x11vnc now runs without a
   password, so the noVNC tab is open.
2. reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh: removed the x11vnc password
   generation block (the tr | head temp file workaround is
   now a no-op comment).
3. Final banner: no longer prints a password; instead notes
   "(no password — LAN-only)".

If the operator wants a VNC password back later, uncomment
the block in the bootstrap. The "Reset Audio" button on the
launcher is unchanged.
